purpose: Read-only GET requests made on 2026-10-03 after the measurement summarized in input.json, to answer review findings on the receipt (the cache count, the selection of the Validate failure anatomy, the composition of the cancelled runs and the retention period): each call's exact argument vector, UTC start and end time, exit code, stdout sha256 and byte length, and the fields derived from the returned payloads. These are later observations, not part of the original measurement.
client: gh REST GET calls (gh api --method GET); none used -f or -F, which would switch a request to POST
working_directory: a checkout of this repository; the calls do not read the working tree
payloads: Withheld from publication: the list-runs payloads carry commit author names and email addresses and actor profiles. Each call's stdout sha256 and byte length are listed; the payloads are kept outside the repository and their retention is not guaranteed. The derived fields below are the published sanitization; nothing else was derived from the payloads.

calls.how_to_rebuild_an_argv: argv_prefix followed by the group's argv_after_prefix, with {repo} and the row's parameter values substituted in the order of parameters; the builder checked that every rebuilt argv equals the argv that ran
calls.note: The six cache calls ran as two batches of three chained commands; each batch's start and end times are given for its three calls. A --paginate call's stdout is its pages concatenated. Every exit code was 0.

validate_failed_pull_request_runs.query: actions/workflows/validate.yml/runs?status=failure&created=<day>&per_page=100&event=pull_request for each UTC day 2026-09-25 to 2026-10-02 (one page each)
validate_failed_pull_request_runs.classification_rule: A failing job instance is a job of the run's latest attempt (actions/runs/<id>/jobs?filter=latest&per_page=100) whose conclusion is failure, attributed to its first step whose conclusion is failure and labelled by step_labels; policy_gate counts the sota-sources, verdict-review-gate and secret-scan instances and real_test_or_gate every other instance.
